rules.content:
title: RDGA Registration Timing Pattern Detection
status: experimental
description: Detects clusters of domain registrations exhibiting algorithmically regular timing intervals in zone file diffs, a hallmark of Registered Domain Generation Algorithm (RDGA) infrastructure provisioning
logsource:
    product: dns_intelligence
    service: zone_file_diff
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "domain_registration"
        registration_source: "zone_file_diff"
    aggregation:
        count|gte: 15
        groupby: "registrant_cluster_id"
        timeframe: "1h"
    timing_regularity:
        inter_registration_stddev|lte: 2.0
    condition: selection and aggregation and timing_regularity
level: high
rules.title: DL-0092: RDGA Registration Timing Pattern Detection (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: RDGA Nameserver Clustering Anomaly
status: experimental
description: Detects disproportionate concentration of newly registered domains pointing to the same nameserver infrastructure within a 24-hour window. RDGA operators typically provision hundreds or thousands of d
logsource:
    product: dns_intelligence
    service: zone_file_diff
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "domain_registration"
        registration_source: "zone_file_diff"
    aggregation:
        count|gte: 50
        groupby: "nameserver_fqdn"
        timeframe: "24h"
    exclusion:
        nameserver_fqdn|endswith:
            - ".registrar-servers.com"
            - ".domaincontrol.com"
            - ".cloudflare.com"
            - ".awsdns-"
            - ".googledomains.com"
    condition: selection and aggregation and not exclusion
level: high
rules.title: DL-0093: RDGA Nameserver Clustering Anomaly (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: RDGA Registrar Concentration Anomaly
status: experimental
description: Detects anomalous concentration of new domain registrations at a single registrar that share lexical similarity patterns and nameserver infrastructure, indicating RDGA-driven bulk registration campaig
logsource:
    product: dns_intelligence
    service: zone_file_diff
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "domain_registration"
        registration_source: "zone_file_diff"
    aggregation:
        count|gte: 30
        groupby: "registrar_iana_id"
        timeframe: "24h"
    lexical_similarity:
        domain_cluster_similarity_score|gte: 0.7
    nameserver_overlap:
        shared_nameserver_ratio|gte: 0.6
    condition: selection and aggregation and lexical_similarity and nameserver_overlap
level: medium
rules.title: DL-0094: RDGA Registrar Concentration Anomaly (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Bulk Let's Encrypt Certificate Issuance Clustering
status: experimental
description: Detects clusters of Let's Encrypt certificate issuances for domains sharing nameserver or registrar characteristics within a short time window. RDGA and AI-generated campaigns frequently provision cer
logsource:
    product: dns_intelligence
    service: ct_log
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "certificate_issuance"
        issuer_org: "Let's Encrypt"
        registration_to_cert_delta|lte: "24h"
    aggregation:
        count|gte: 15
        groupby: "nameserver_cluster"
        timeframe: "6h"
    condition: selection and aggregation
level: high
rules.title: DL-0099: Bulk Let's Encrypt Certificate Issuance Clustering (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Zone File Daily Diff Anomaly Detection
status: experimental
description: Detects anomalous patterns in daily zone file diffs: unusual volume of new registrations in a single TLD, concentration of registrations at specific registrars, or patterns suggesting algorithmic gene
logsource:
    product: dns_intelligence
    service: zone_file_diff
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "zone_file_new_entry"
        registration_volume_zscore|gte: 3.0
    aggregation:
        count|gte: 50
        groupby: "registrar_id, tld"
        timeframe: "24h"
    condition: selection and aggregation
level: high
rules.title: DL-0100: Zone File Daily Diff Anomaly Detection (Sigma)
